OptionalBlockRefOrExecutionNumberOrTag.name: blockRefOrNumberOrTag
OptionalBlockRefOrExecutionNumberOrTag.description: The block to execute against, given as its height in hex or in decimal, as a tag, as a 32-byte block hash, or as a block reference object. Optional: the call is executed against the best block when it is omitted.

schema.title: optionalBlockRefOrExecutionNumberOrTag
schema.description: A string of `0x` and exactly 64 hex digits is always read as a block hash, never as a height.
